answer: Reputation decays unless refreshed by beacon-chosen unrelated peers cross-examining it. A new identity needs a voyage through that lineup: each examiner logs the check on a separate ledger, so clones must bridge to independent peers rather than each other. Attacker cost is the walnut: every clone pairing needs fresh stake plus examiner fees drawn from outside the clone set, and verifying the union of N identities grows quadratically, not linearly.
